$comment: Ground truth for the invoice vision corpus. See README.md in this directory.
Ground truth is established by a HUMAN READING THE INVOICE — never by recording what
the model returned, which would enshrine today's errors as the standard.
Partial truth is fine: expectTotal alone still catches a model that drops line items.
THIS REPO IS PUBLIC. Synthetic and sample invoices only — see README.md.

schema.case: what this fixture is testing — the awkwardness it represents
schema.isAutomotive: boolean. false = a control that validateConsultantDocument must REJECT
schema.expectVendor: shop name as printed, or null if not asserting
schema.expectTotal: number, or null. The single most useful assertion
schema.expectLineItemCount: integer, or null. Catches silent truncation
schema.notes: anything a human needs to know — unreadable fields, ambiguity, why truth is partial
